cannot_assess_reason: The photo is taken from a very low angle along the rail, so most tie tops are seen edge-on and are partly covered by ballast stones. The rail bodies hide the fastening areas. The right-hand rail base and its fastenings are in deep shadow or blocked from view, and the ties become too small to judge toward the distance. Fastener presence and tie-surface condition cannot be judged reliably from this view. This is not a finding about the track either way.
